summary: This note is a list of A.C. Milan's honours, grouped by competition type: domestic, continental and worldwide. It gives the number of titles won in each competition and the seasons or years in which they were won. The domestic section includes 18 Serie A titles, and the continental section includes 7 European Cup / UEFA Champions League titles.
one_line: A.C. Milan's football honours list, covering domestic, European and worldwide titles and the years they were won.
key_facts: A.C. Milan won 18 Serie A titles, the first in 1901.
A.C. Milan won 2 Serie B titles, in 1980–81 and 1982–83.
A.C. Milan won 5 Coppa Italia titles, in 1966–67, 1971–72, 1972–73, 1976–77 and 2002–03.
A.C. Milan won 7 Supercoppa Italiana titles, in 1988, 1992, 1993, 1994, 2004, 2011 and 2016.
A.C. Milan won 7 European Cup / UEFA Champions League titles, in 1962–63, 1968–69, 1988–89, 1989–90, 1993–94, 2002–03 and 2006–07.
A.C. Milan won the UEFA Cup Winners' Cup in 1967–68 and 1972–73.
A.C. Milan won 5 UEFA Super Cup titles, in 1989, 1990, 1994, 2003 and 2007.
A.C. Milan won the Intercontinental Cup in 1969, 1989 and 1990.
A.C. Milan won the FIFA Club World Cup in 2007.
